params.prompt: A final-frame image from a prestige stylized 3D animated feature film with a mature, dramatic tone. Fully dimensional sculpted characters and environments, with slightly elongated adult proportions and faces that have real bone structure. Heavy woven wool with natural folds, soft light through the skin, hammered bronze with physically accurate reflections, volumetric dust, soft ray-traced shadows, shallow depth of field and a filmic colour grade. Stylized and sculptural, never photographic. It does not look like a video game, a toy, clay, plastic or a children's cartoon. The scene is a rocky wilderness at dusk. A single bronze serpent with a wedge-shaped head and a hammered, dark-patinated surface winds twice around the top of one straight wooden pole. The pole has no crossbar. It stands in a low mound of stones on the right third of the frame, rising above a camp of low black goat-hair tents. In the near foreground at lower left, a weakened, weathered ancient Near Eastern man in a plain undyed wool robe lies on the stony ground, propped on one arm. He lifts his head and looks up at the bronze serpent, seen in three-quarter profile, with quiet, desperate hope. There are no wounds and no blood. Behind him a few small figures support one another, and some turn their faces toward the pole. Two small dark snakes slide between the stones near his hand. The camera is very low, close to the ground, with a 35mm lens looking up past the man's shoulder toward the serpent. This creates one strong diagonal from lower left to upper right. There are five depth layers: blurred foreground stones, the man, the camp, distant ridges and open sky. The camp has fallen into cool blue-umber shadow. One narrow beam of warm gold light comes from the upper left and falls only on the bronze serpent, with a faint gold reflection on the man's lifted face. Nothing else in the scene is gold. The palette is night umber, clay, ash grey and deep dusk blue, with warm gold as the only bright accent. Vertical 9:16 composition. The top quarter of the frame is calm, empty sky, with the serpent just below it. No text, letters, logos, halos or symbols.
